definitions.matter: 128 computational labels: native pair 0..99, separate vacuum 100, invalid padding 101..127
definitions.record: One two-state complex record; coherent record ancillas may be included
definitions.allowed_matter_operations: Arbitrary permutations and arbitrary diagonal unitary phases in the fixed computational matter basis; never coherent mixing of different matter labels
definitions.allowed_record_operations: Arbitrary unitary record/work operations conditioned on the current matter label, including unconditioned operations
definitions.ancillas: Record/work ancillas only, initialized independently; matter permutations cannot depend on record/work states. A claimed unitary implementation must return work ancillas to the same clean state for every input.
definitions.forbidden: Matter amplitude-mixing gates, basis changes supplied as oracles, measurement/postselection, extra matter-register encodings or record-controlled matter operations
definitions.target: C_Pi=(I-Pi) tensor I+Pi tensor X on all matter and record inputs, with Pi=vvdagger from the actual native scalar vector. It equals the theta=pi/2 interaction rotation up to the additional controlled phase on Pi; here the controlled flip itself is the precisely frozen target.
definitions.scope: An abstract restricted compiler capability claim, not a claim that these are exactly the native geometric operations or physically available gates. The computational basis is fixed by the existing seven-qubit interface.

conjectures.statement: For each of the four native chirality/doublet scalar vectors v, some finite circuit over the declared routing/phase/label-controlled-record gate class implements C_Pi exactly on the full input space, with clean work ancillas.
conjectures.quantifiers: For every supplied native source case, there exists a finite allowed circuit; equality is on every matter-record input, not only the prepared scalar input.
conjectures.acceptance: Exhibit such a circuit and prove full-input equality and clean ancilla restoration.
conjectures.falsifier: Prove a class-wide invariant of allowed circuits and show C_Pi violates it for at least one source case and input.

attempts.verification_level: Written finite-circuit induction plus exact native-source counterexamples and positive-control matrix checks
attempts.admission: Not imported into an existing shared graph; no independent outcome admission claimed.
